stories.title: Trump waives 100% tariff on Russian oil, GTRI says relief for India is temporary
stories.summary: The Global Trade and Investment (GTRI) think tank said that President Donald Trump’s waiver of a threatened 100 percent tariff on Russian oil imports gives India only temporary relief, because the United States could reinstate the duties at any time. GTRI noted ongoing U.S. purchases of Russian diesel, tariff protection for China and current India‑U.S. trade talks as possible reasons, and urged New Delhi to protect its energy security and avoid permanent trade concessions.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
stories.previousTitle: Trump waives 100% tariffs on Russian oil, giving India temporary relief
stories.previousSummary: GTRI warned that the waiver of a threatened 100% tariff on Russian oil provides only short‑term relief for India because the United States could reinstate the duty at any time. The think tank cited U.S. purchases of Russian diesel, tariff protection for China and ongoing India‑U.S. trade talks as possible reasons, and urged New Delhi to protect its energy security and avoid permanent trade concessions tied to reversible relief.

stories.title: Trump suspends Russia sanctions amid dispute with Zelensky
stories.summary: Donald Trump issued an executive order on Friday night to suspend several Russia sanctions that were scheduled to take effect two days later, saying the pause was in the U.S. “national interest.” The sanctions had been passed by Congress and signed into law by Trump in September. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky condemned the move as a complete disregard of the measures, amid a broader row that includes a U.S. deal to import Russian diesel and Ukrainian accusations of reduced military support.
stories.why: The suspension could weaken U.S. pressure on Russia and impact Ukraine’s ability to secure international backing.
stories.previousTitle: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
stories.previousSummary: Donald Trump has blocked numerous sanctions on Russia two days before they were due to take effect, as a row with his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky deepens. The sanctions were passed by the US Congress and signed into law by Trump in September.

stories.title: Masked settlers attack Palestinians and journalist during West Bank olive harvest
stories.summary: Dozens of masked settlers attacked Palestinians harvesting olives near the village of Abu Falah in the occupied West Bank, setting fire to cars and olive trees. The violence injured at least 12 Palestinians, including four dual Palestinian‑American citizens, and a foreign journalist. An American citizen named Majdi was struck with nail‑studded sticks, sustaining head wounds, and his elderly mother was also hurt.
stories.why: The incident shows the danger to civilians and journalists working in the olive‑harvest area of the occupied West Bank.
stories.previousTitle: Masked settlers attack Palestinian olive harvesters and journalist in West Bank
stories.previousSummary: Dozens of masked settlers attacked Palestinians harvesting olives near the village of Abu Falah in the occupied West Bank, setting fire to cars and olive trees. A local official said 12 Palestinians were injured, including four who hold both Palestinian and American citizenship, and a foreign journalist was also hurt. Settlers used guns, rocks and nail‑studded sticks, wounding an American farmer and his elderly mother.

stories.title: White House lists investment over $330 billion in US from India
stories.summary: The White House announced investments of over $330 billion from India as part of total investments. US President Donald Trump previously mentioned Reliance Industries' $300 billion investment in Texas.
stories.why: This matters because it could affect India’s economy, major industries, investment, jobs or trade.
stories.previousTitle: White House says Indian investment in U.S. exceeds $330 billion
stories.previousSummary: The White House announced that cumulative Indian investment in the United States totals more than $330 billion, contributing to a reported $10.871 trillion in foreign and private‑sector inflows from all sources. The announcement cited specific projects such as a $15 billion steel plant by Essar Group and referenced earlier statements by President Trump about a proposed $300 billion Reliance Industries investment in Texas.
